summary: Backend-only verification of the lead-reassignment history-wipe fix. Wrote pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_reassignment_wipe.py covering all 5 reassignment paths (PATCH /leads/{id}, POST /leads/assign, POST /leads/round-robin, POST /shared-leads/move, POST /shared-leads/assign) plus two regression cases. All 8 tests pass. Verified: notes deleted, call_logs deleted, per-lead audit_logs deleted (stale status_changed entries no longer appear in /leads/{id}/activity), lead_status reset to Uncalled, and appointment_at / effective_date / completed_at / completed_by_user_id / enrolled_carrier / enrolled_plan / application_info / hra_info all cleared. Fresh 'lead_assigned' audit is preserved AFTER wipe so the receiving agent still sees the transfer in the Activity tab. /api/leaderboard and /api/users/{id}/activity-history remain healthy after per-lead audit deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: _wipe_lead_history now correctly deletes db.audit_logs entries with entity_type='lead' — this is the core fix and it works end-to-end.

All 5 reassignment endpoints (PATCH /leads, /leads/assign, /leads/round-robin, /shared-leads/move, /shared-leads/assign) now consistently clear enrolled_carrier and enrolled_plan in their $set block — parity achieved.

Minor: /api/leads DELETE (single) at line 913 wipes notes+call_logs but NOT audit_logs for the deleted lead; not part of this bug but leaves orphan audit rows referencing a deleted entity. Consider harmonising with _wipe_lead_history if audit consistency matters.
server.py is 2329 lines — long-term should be split into routers (leads, shared_leads, imports, metrics, brochures).

Comment on line 82-88 in _wipe_lead_history slightly misleading — it says audit_logs are 'intentionally preserved' in the docstring line 76 but then deletes them below. Clean up the contradictory doc comment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reassignment history-wipe is fully verified across all 5 endpoints. If future iterations touch lead reassignment or audit trail, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_reassignment_wipe.py.
rca of the issue: iter9/10 wiped notes+call_logs on reassignment but left per-lead audit_logs intact, so the receiving agent saw stale status_changed entries in the Activity tab. Additionally the bulk /leads/assign, /leads/round-robin, /shared-leads/move, and /shared-leads/assign endpoints omitted enrolled_carrier and enrolled_plan from their reset $set block. Fix: (1) _wipe_lead_history now also deletes audit_logs where entity_type='lead' and entity_id in ids; (2) all four bulk endpoints now include enrolled_carrier=None and enrolled_plan=None. Verified end-to-end via pytest.
